content: I need a channel beam with 70mm width, 40mm height, a length 450mm with a wall thickness of 5mm, which is open on the top side | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.name: CreateCode
function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate the dimensions for the channel beam\\nwidth = 70  # Total width of the channel beam\\nheight = 40  # Total height of the channel beam\\nlength = 450  # Length of the channel beam\\nwall_thickness = 5  # Wall thickness of the channel beam\\n\\n# Calculate the inner dimensions for the subtracted part\\ninner_width = width - 2 * wall_thickness\\ninner_height = height - wall_thickness  # Open on the top side, so only subtract wall thickness once\\n\\n# Prepare the variables for the block function calls\\nouter_block = {\\n    \\\"x_size\\\": [width],\\n    \\\"y_size\\\": [length],\\n    \\\"z_size\\\": [height],\\n    \\\"x\\\": [0],\\n    \\\"y\\\": [0],\\n    \\\"z\\\": [0],\\n    \\\"subtraction\\\": [False]\\n}\\n\\ninner_block = {\\n    \\\"x_size\\\": [inner_width],\\n    \\\"y_size\\\": [length],\\n    \\\"z_size\\\": [inner_height],\\n    \\\"x\\\": [wall_thickness],\\n    \\\"y\\\": [0],\\n    \\\"z\\\": [0],\\n    \\\"subtraction\\\": [True]\\n}\\n\\n(outer_block, inner_block)\"}"

content:
{"PythonCode":"# Calculate the dimensions for the channel beam
width = 70  # Total width of the channel beam
height = 40  # Total height of the channel beam
length = 450  # Length of the channel beam
wall_thickness = 5  # Wall thickness of the channel beam

# Calculate the inner dimensions for the subtracted part
inner_width = width - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_height = height - wall_thickness  # Open on the top side, so only subtract wall thickness once

# Prepare the variables for the block function calls
outer_block = {
    "x_size": [width],
    "y_size": [length],
    "z_size": [height],
    "x": [0],
    "y": [0],
    "z": [0],
    "subtraction": [False]
}

inner_block = {
    "x_size": [inner_width],
    "y_size": [length],
    "z_size": [inner_height],
    "x": [wall_thickness],
    "y": [0],
    "z": [0],
    "subtraction": [True]
}

(outer_block, inner_block)"}
